subject: Request: transient H100 allocation & overage smoothing for TritonML pilot
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@tritonml.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Jul 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: transient H100 allocation & overage smoothing for TritonML pilot

Alex —

Thanks again for the deep dive this morning. Per our conversation and the workload profile you sent, TritonML's production pilot will heavily favor long-context generative workloads for the first 8 weeks. Your engineering ask is fairly clear: a transient H100 allocation for the dedicated pool + an elevated burst buffer for the first 30 days to avoid throttling during model warm-up.

High level commercial ask from your side: a reduced overage rate (25% below standard) for any burst beyond reserved hours during the 30-day window, and the ability to temporarily pin H100 instances rather than the usual A100 fallback.

I've attached the workload spec and our initial cost model. We can do the engineering side (route + pinning + KV cache warm-start) but the H100 pinning + discounted overage requires Deal Desk + exec approval because it deviates from standard SKU mapping and pricing tiers. Can you confirm the pilot start date (you mentioned Aug 9) and that the 30-day burst window is sufficient?

Next steps I propose: I will escalate for approval today and loop in Contracts for an amendment if we get signoff. If we get greenlight by EOD Thursday we can start provisioning the week of Aug 2.

Thanks —
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0192

Attachments: TritonML_ML_Workload_Specs.pdf, cost-model-breakdown.xlsx

From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@tritonml.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Jul 2027 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: transient H100 allocation & overage smoothing for TritonML pilot

Hannah —

Confirmed: pilot start Aug 9, initial 30-day ramp makes sense. The engineering team expects peak burst of ~6K GPU-hours in week 1 as they run long-context fine-tuning + evaluation. We can't tolerate the automatic A100 fallback for correctness reasons on a subset of models — outputs differ materially.

On the commercial ask, if Redwood can commit to H100 pinning for the 30 days and the 25% overage discount for bursts above the reserved cushion, we will sign the amendment immediately. We can put a hold on the first invoice until provisioning is confirmed.

Alex Chen
Head of Platform, TritonML
alex.chen@tritonml.com

--
Alex Chen
TritonML

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request: transient H100 allocation & overage smoothing for TritonML pilot

Team — escalating for approval. Key facts:
- Account: TritonML (DEAL-4721)
- Pilot start: Aug 9 (confirmed)
- Ask: temporary H100 reservation for dedicated pool (30 days), burst buffer for week 1 (~6K GPU-hours peak), and overage rate set to 25% below standard for the 30-day window.
- Risk: H100 inventory is constrained in US-west region; pinning prevents automatic fallback to A100 that would otherwise preserve capacity.
- Commercial: Triton will sign an amendment immediately if we can agree. They request invoices held until provisioning as a courtesy.

Attached: proposed-amendment-tritonml.docx and cost-model-breakdown.xlsx. Suggested approval options:
1) Approve H100 pin + 25% overage discount for 30 days; cap burst at 10K GPU-hours; finance to net-charge any overage monthly.
2) Approve H100 pin + smaller overage discount (10%) with stricter burst cap (6K).

Asking for a decision by EOD so we can meet provisioning lead times. If any of you want more telemetry before signing off, I can have infra run a quick capacity check.

Thanks —
Hannah

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: transient H100 allocation & overage smoothing for TritonML pilot

Hannah / team — thanks for the concise summary. After a quick check with Capacity Planning (I copied internal notes into the deal record), I'm comfortable approving a controlled exception with these conditions:

Decision (approved) — temporary H100 pinning + discounted overage
- Duration: 30 calendar days starting at provisioning (max 90 days if extended by mutual agreement).
- Burst cap: hard cap at 10,000 GPU-hours for the 30-day window. Any usage above the cap will revert to standard overage rates.
- Overage rate: 25% below standard rate for usage within the burst cap. Above cap reverts.
- Financial hold: Triton may request invoice hold for first month; finance to approve on a case-by-case basis.
- Technical: Ops to enable automatic KV-cache warm-start and explicit model pinning; infra to provide a provisioning ETA within 48 hours of signature.

Conditions to close: we need a one-page amendment (Contracts) that lists the cap and duration, plus an exec-signed approval line. Vanessa / Laura — please prepare the amendment and the DocuSign link. Karthik / Ops — confirm capacity in US-west and add a fallback fallback-policy (automated notification + 1-hour cooldown) in case of global pressure.

Markus
Markus Klein
VP, Revenue Operations
